summary: Very steep narrow cul-de-sac kerb with homes 12 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and pools on every side, nearest 12 m; not secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow court on a steep hill with trees over the lane; little room to pull off.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parked cars seen along this side.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb, mostly from the east and south.
